rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Meta-frame lectures are closers, not openers.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No embedded lecture is a meta-frame closer misplaced as an opener. 'The far half of the map' (line 37) is a ceiling-shower/spirit opener (arc-lecture carve-out). 'The agent loop' + 'Test and learn' (lines 41/43) teach vocabulary mid-module. 'The ironies of automation' (line 57) arms the student against a trap right before the risky send-off — a warning, not a recognition of a pattern already lived. 'Will company memory emerge?' (line 100) and 'Reading the return' (line 102) are open-question/bridge lectures pointed at M5, not this module's own closer.

Rule scoped to M5-style contrast-mood modules (learn-through-doing, name-after). This module's deliberate mood is curious readiness (strategy doc §M4), not contrast-mood — M5 owns that mood. Not the surface this rule governs.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Big Idea (lines 3-4) leads with 'Walk... fill... send it off... learn' — positive disciplines. 'The ironies of automation' and 'The lethal trifecta' keep their canonical failure-named titles under the named-canonical-result carve-out (§3), which the rule permits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategy-fidelity (consolidates front-run check, module-to-module arc, Big Idea fidelity, mood-doesn't-resolve-early).
rules_evaluated.evidence: Big Idea and Key Concepts match strategy doc §M4 ('walk what you've built... fill the obvious gaps, and send off — un-packaged') in spirit. No front-run: the module names no downstream framework/skill it hasn't earned, and defers packaging entirely to M5 ('No compound pass at the close... Module 5 builds', line 59). Module-to-module arc: ## Next hands off 'what came back, or what you caught before it went further' (line 106) to M5's opening read. Mood doesn't resolve early: trace.close.mood_note confirms 'not resolved, not anxious' — a genuine 'let's see', matching the requirement that M4 not feel tidy at close.

teaching_moment_lands: The trifecta check before the send-off prompt (line 81) is the module's load-bearing teaching moment — it fires inline in body prose immediately before the final forcing-function prompt, not skippable, and the trace confirms the persona recognizes it as the M3 leash-check returning ('recognises it as M3's leash-check returning pointed at this run') and acts on it (cuts one leg) before pasting the send-off prompt. Reliable across reasonable persona-skill variation: the check is unconditional body text on the critical path, not an optional aside the persona could route around.
